root.name: Norte
root.summary: Small streetwear brand from Bogotá selling on Instagram, TikTok and Shopify to 18-28 year olds, growing through limited drops.
diagnosis: Streetwear brand run by two people, sells online through drops.
Covered: product design, Instagram posting by hand.
Gap: no content calendar; posts are improvised the day of.
Gap: no check before posting; wrong prices and dates have gone out.
Gap: cash for each drop planned by gut feeling.
